title: Create your first workflow
description: Walk through creating a workflow from scratch — connect a data source, pick a model, and run it.

steps.title: Workflows tab
steps.body: Workflows are the automated pipelines you build here. Click into it.

steps.title: New workflow
steps.body: Click here to start a blank workflow. You'll get an empty canvas to build on.

steps.title: Add your first node
steps.body: Every workflow is a chain of nodes. The first node is usually a data source or an input.

steps.title: Run it
steps.body: When you're ready, hit Run. You can inspect outputs at each step in the results panel.
